item.title: Elegant Antenna Design: The Four-Band Octagon Dipole
item.description:
You know what I appreciate? When someone takes a complex problem and solves it with elegant engineering instead of brute-force complexity.

Robert, N6MRO, designed a four-band ham-stick dipole that does exactly that. It’s a multi-band antenna that works efficiently on 10, 20, 40, and 80 meters without the complexity usually required for such performance.

The Challenge
